limitations: Occurrence files are bounded, non-random PBDB API-prefix samples with unknown selection probability; they are not exhaustive or statistically representative exports.

The continental layer is a CAO2024 model snapshot at one midpoint per geological period, not a direct observation or continuous paleogeographic movie; it is not assumed to be co-registered with PBDB paleocoordinates.
The atlas-wide hierarchy is a navigation ontology, not a phylogenetic hypothesis; the separate Perissodactyla hypothesis has no time-scaled branch lengths.
First and last appearances are sampling-dependent observations, not exact origination or extinction dates.
Observed density and missing records cannot be interpreted as biological richness or absence without sampling controls.
scopeStatement: This release is a curated educational navigation subset centered on plants, selected invertebrate groups and vertebrates; registry completeness is measured only against the included ontology.
